integrity: Finite code tests are supplementary, not a proof for all lengths. Full structural proof and conditions are in RESULT.md. Literature checks are best effort, not priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for linear binary words of weight exactly two and at most one directed 01 to 10 adjacent swap only; no reverse swaps, deletion, or multiple errors. Optimal code-size formula does not classify all maximum codes. An undiscovered equivalent specialization of older peak-shift literature cannot be excluded.
title: Exact one-sided adjacent-transposition capacity in the binary weight-two layer
